shortDescription: Manage C(schematics_inventorys) for Schematics Service API.

options.name: description
options.description: The description of your Inventory definition. The description can be up to 2048 characters long in size.

options.name: force
options.description: Equivalent to -force options in the command line.

options.name: inventories_ini
options.description: Input inventory of host and host group for the playbook, in the C(.ini) file format.

options.name: inventory_id
options.description:
Resource Inventory Id.
Use C(GET /v2/inventories) API to look up the Resource Inventory definition Ids  in your IBM Cloud account.

options.name: location
options.description:
List of locations supported by IBM Cloud Schematics service.
While creating your workspace or action, choose the right region, since it cannot be changed.
Note, this does not limit the location of the IBM Cloud resources, provisioned using Schematics.

options.name: name
options.description:
The unique name of your Inventory definition.
The name can be up to 128 characters long and can include alphanumeric characters, spaces, dashes, and underscores.

options.name: profile
options.description: Level of details returned by the get method.

options.name: propagate
options.description: Auto propagate the chaange or deletion to the dependent resources.

options.name: resource_group
options.description: Resource-group name for the Inventory definition.   By default, Inventory definition will be created in Default Resource Group.

options.name: resource_queries
options.description: Input resource query definitions that is used to dynamically generate the inventory of host and host group for the playbook.

options.name: state
options.description: Should the resource be present or absent.
